sites.name: Corporate headquarters
sites.description: Corporate headquarters in Santa Clara, California, about 941,000 square feet leased.

source.label: Palo Alto Networks Form 10-K for fiscal 2026 (year ended July 31, 2026), Item 2. Properties
source.quote: Our corporate headquarters is located in Santa Clara, California, where we lease approximately 941,000 square feet of space under three lease agreements that expire in July 2040

notes: Palo Alto Networks publishes no state or country impact report that was found. The FY2026 10-K gives a global workforce of 21,921 (July 31, 2026) with no geographic split; Item 2 names the leased Santa Clara HQ (~941,000 sq ft, leases now running to July 2040, plus 24.9 owned acres next to it), leased space "around the world, including Israel and India", and data centers under co-location arrangements in the United States, Europe and Asia, with no figures. The only geographic footprint figures are long-lived assets (PP&E plus operating lease ROU assets) for the U.S., Israel and other countries, now printed in whole $ millions (total $1,223 million, at July 31, 2026, against $734 million a year earlier).
